subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear John, Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at XYZ Company. We have received your resume and cover letter and are currently in the process of reviewing all applications. We will be in touch with you within the next two weeks to schedule an interview if your qualifications match our requirements. In the meantime, feel free to reach out if you have any questions. Best regards, Jane Smith HR Manager
